sql.cs_students: SELECT name FROM students WHERE major = 'Computer Science' ORDER BY year, name;
sql.course_counts: SELECT course_code, COUNT(*) FROM enrollments GROUP BY course_code;
sql.averages: SELECT s.name, AVG(e.grade) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id WHERE s.major = 'Computer Science' AND e.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id;
sql.enrol: INSERT INTO enrollments (student_id, course_code, grade) VALUES (4, 'CS201', NULL);
sql.grade: UPDATE enrollments SET grade = 90 WHERE student_id = 1 AND course_code = 'CS210';
sql.advisors: CREATE TABLE advisors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, student_id INTEGER REFERENCES students(id));
sql.no_enrolments: SELECT s.name FROM students s LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id WHERE e.course_code IS NULL;
